search_window.basis: Prior verified heartbeat completion through this observed run. A date-only posting, without reliable publication hour or independently demonstrated incident onset, does not establish newness within the hourly interval.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary high-value miss-class recall. Production nationwide Food Line collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Only/sole/last/full-service community grocery store lost to closure, fire or disaster
Emergency food distribution canceled or suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food bank service closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP, WIC or other food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "only full-service grocery" closure town fire November 2026
"emergency food distribution" suspended weather power November 5 2026

reviewed_candidates.exclusion_reason: Indexed snippet showed a November 5 2:30–4 PM mandatory-meeting WIC closure (routine preplanned short closure, not abrupt emergency interruption); directly fetched current page instead displayed a stale September 7 Labor Day closure, so November 5 details were not independently confirmed. No new qualifying immediate disruption verified.
Official Jamestown, ND announcement schedules Great Plains Food Bank distribution for November 5, 5:15–6:30 PM; no cancellation or suspension reported.
Provider currently lists seven November 5 Michigan mobile-pantry distributions. No cancellation or suspension established; calendar alone is not proof that each event completed.
Butler, Indiana only full-service grocery closure is from May 2026, well outside interval.
Spencer, New York only full-service grocery fire occurred September 2026, not new.
Historical November 2025 SNAP interruption; false positive from year-matched search.
Union County, NJ EBT replacement-card delay already recorded in November 4 watch ledger; duplicate, not new.

coverage_notes.result: No newly verified qualifying high-value U.S. food-access disruption within the hourly observation interval.
coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve targeted indexed searches do not establish nationwide absence; indexed hits frequently surfaced older closures, 2025 SNAP notices and routine food pantry schedules. One government WIC page had an index/direct-view mismatch, preventing confirmation of an indexed routine short closure. No tool search or direct-page access failure.
coverage_notes.action_limits: No approval, publication, production collector modification, schedule alteration, or task disabling.
